verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party pages name a dedicated "Collective Mode" and describe links that show combined availability for you and any number of teammates, so recipients book a time with the whole selected group. It also lets you include external colleagues' calendars in team availability. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that slots appear only when every host is free, a documented way to mark hosts as required versus optional, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
